draft_text: Thornbill-NER appears somewhat robust to label noise in its training annotations.
rationale: The package contains no label-noise experiments. Only original-label training (exp1) is reported, with no perturbation conditions, no robustness criterion applied, and no statistical tests. The claim about robustness to label noise has no supporting evidence.
